inline_prompts:
You are given a string S of length N consisting of 0 and 1. 
You may perform the following operation any number of times (possibly zero):
- Choose an integer i and swap the i-th and (i+1)-th characters of S.
Find the minimum number of operations needed so that all 1s are contiguous. Here, all 1s are said to be contiguous if and only if there exist integers l and r (1 \leq l \leq r \leq N) such that the i-th character of S is 1 if and only if l \leq i \leq r, and 0 otherwise. Yes, if the string already has all 1s contiguous, the expected output is 0.

- 2 \leq N \leq 5 \times 10^5

- S is a length N string of 0 and 1.
